Sanjay: Quick follow-up on the switchback RFC — proposing a runtime hook to do per-request 'precision switchback' for tail tokens when confidence drops. TL;DR: runtime can fall back FP8 -> INT8 -> 4-bit per-layer for last N tokens to fix hallucinations without a full model swap. Thoughts?

Maria: Sounds promising. Ops concern: this feels like it could create bursty recompute and increase latency variance. How cheap is the confidence calc? prob-threshold? :thinking:

Kevin: Prototype data: confidence = rolling token logprob (window=3). Works but adds ~0.6ms/token on A100. Biggest cost is recompute when switching precision due to kernel selection and possible re-quantization.

Elaine: If we keep pre-quantized weight copies we avoid re-quant, but memory overhead goes up. Rollout suggestion: canary on endpoints with lenient SLOs first.

Sanjay: Runtime sketch / config example: ```
precision.switchback: {
  enabled: true,
  window: 3,
  thresh: -3.5,
  warm_cache: ["fp8", "int8"],
  max_recompute_ms: 50
}
```

Maria: Metrics we need: `switchback_rate`, `recompute_ms`, tail latency p50/p95, `quality_regressions`. Operational rule: abort switchback if `recompute_ms` > 40ms for 3 consecutive requests -> fallback to model-variant.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary to `eng-ml-staging` in 15m. Logs -> #eng-ml-canary stream.

Kevin: I'll add a synthetic prompt suite that triggers long-memory hallucinations and measure detection/repair success. Also will benchmark memory cost of keeping pre-quantized copies.

Elaine: Add a safety hysteresis: require two consecutive low-confidence windows before switching and a cooldown of N tokens after a switch to avoid oscillation. If quality drops post-switch (confidence decreases further), immediately revert.

Sanjay: Action items: (1) Kevin: synthetic set + mem benchmarks, (2) Maria: define SLO gates & alert thresholds, (3) Elaine: draft canary runbook with abort criteria, (4) Sanjay: add switchback API sketch and open RFC PR (target EOD).

Kevin: Ack — will PR tests + harness by EOD.

Maria: I'll prototype alert dashboard panels and add `switchback_rate` to cost dashboards.

Elaine: Will draft the runbook and include playbook steps for ops to disable warm_cache and force model-variant fallback.

Sanjay: Great, thanks everyone. We'll sync tomorrow in the RFC follow-up meeting. :thumbsup:
